scripts.dev: node scripts/workspace.mjs run dev next dev --hostname 127.0.0.1
scripts.build: node scripts/workspace.mjs run build next build
scripts.start: node scripts/workspace.mjs run start next start --hostname 0.0.0.0
scripts.format:check: node scripts/workspace.mjs run format:check prettier --check src tests scripts/*.ts scripts/workspace.mjs *.ts *.mjs package.json components.json compose.yaml render.yaml
scripts.typecheck: node scripts/workspace.mjs run typecheck next typegen && tsc --noEmit
scripts.test: node scripts/workspace.mjs run test vitest run
scripts.test:e2e: node scripts/workspace.mjs run test:e2e playwright test
scripts.test:guardian:e2e: E2E_DATA_SOURCE=database E2E_PORT=3106 node scripts/workspace.mjs run test:guardian:e2e playwright test --config=playwright.guardian.config.ts
scripts.test:compat: node scripts/workspace.mjs run test:compat playwright test --config=playwright.compat.config.ts
scripts.test:failure: node scripts/workspace.mjs run test:failure tsx --test tests/failure/*.test.ts
scripts.test:integration: node scripts/workspace.mjs run test:integration tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/integration/*.test.ts
scripts.test:sol: node scripts/workspace.mjs run test:sol playwright test --config=playwright.sol.config.ts
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
